citations.claim: energy grows monotonically in free flight with no walls or controller work
vertical velocity gain in one step (~1.26) is ~6x the correct g*dt (~0.21)
first violating step: energy exceeds allowed limit

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.021381913647630958 to 0.002 with identical bodies, gravity, seed and 4 steps; correct g*dt integration restores energy conservation so no violation.

explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls, controller disabled, work 0) gains energy every step. vy grows by ~1.26 per dt=0.02138 step while g*dt=0.21, i.e. effective gravity ~6x too large; positions confirm the over-large fall. Semi-implicit Euler with fast-body substepping (41-43 substeps/step reported) is over-applying gravity per step, injecting spurious kinetic energy faster than potential loss, so total energy climbs ~43 J/step until it breaches the 10%+5J bound at step 4. Small-dt rerun conserves energy.
vision_note: A single blue circle drops vertically in empty space, falling noticeably farther each step and reaching low in the arena by step 4. No walls, collisions, or other bodies are visible to add energy.
